priority.description: The priority for invalidation queue entries generated by the job.

nodePool.description:
The nodePool of servers that are expected to run the associated {@link DataValidationBatchJob}s.
Only servers with a matching nodePool will process jobs.

sync.description: If false, the {@link DataValidationRuleset#validate} is done asynchronously.

batchSize.description: The maximum number of rules to be evaluated in each batch.

persistProgress.description:
Specifies whether DataValidationResults should be upserted immediately after rule execution(true) or at the end (false).
Only applies to map reduce execution. Batch jobs will always persist progress after each rule is executed.

doNotRun.description: If true, specifies that job should be returned without running it.

doNotMarkComplete.description: If true, the {@link DataValidationRun} will not be marked with a runStatus of complete after it is finished.

rulesetId.description:
The ID of the root ruleset to be used for data validation.
This ruleset contains the specific validation logic and rules to be applied on the data.
It is essential to define this in order to specify which validation criteria the data must meet.

For example: 'reliability_rule_1234'

validationArgs.description:
A map of arguments that the validation rules need in order to be executed.
These arguments are dynamically provided based on the specific ruleset and validation logic.
The map contains key-value pairs where the keys represent the names of the validation parameters,
and the values represent their corresponding values.

For example:
- key: "max_threshold", value: 100
- key: "min_value", value: 5

This allows the validation rules to be more flexible and customizable.

title:
This type represents the specification of data validation for reliability risk management.
It extends the `DataValidationExecutionSpec` and includes additional parameters
required for executing a data validation process, specifically for reliability data.

The `ReliabilityDataValidationSpec` provides details about the ruleset used for data validation
and the specific arguments needed for the validation rules. It ensures that the provided data
complies with the defined reliability validation rules before further processing or modeling.
name: ReliabilityDataValidationSpec
